items.question: How long will my concrete driveway last?
items.answer: With proper installation and maintenance, a Maxima Concrete driveway can last 30 years or more.

items.question: Can I get a decorative driveway like the ones shown?
items.answer: Yes. We offer stamped, colored, bordered, and exposed aggregate driveways tailored to your home.

items.question: How long does a driveway installation take?
items.answer: Most driveways are completed in 3–5 days, depending on size and site conditions.

items.question: Do you offer free driveway estimates?
items.answer: Yes. We provide free on-site consultations and estimates across Central Ohio.
